summary: Retested the 502 bug fix and the new 'Solo giochi' filter. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass. GET /api/search reliably returns 200 (no 502) for zelda, mario, assassin's creed, spiderman across two consecutive calls each; JSON body includes 'results' <=20 items, every row has an is_game boolean. Accessories (Amiibo, Funko, LEGO, Custodia, Volante, Portachiavi, Peluche, Playset, 'Il Film', Controller, Steelbook, Tazza) are correctly flagged is_game=false; canonical games (The Legend of Zelda Tears of the Kingdom, Breath of the Wild, Echoes of Wisdom, Assassin's Creed Valhalla/Odyssey/Origins/Mirage/Shadows) are is_game=true. /api/product regression: cold ~2-6s, warm cache < 1s, prices for Zelda ToTK stable (nuovo=80.99, usato=59.99, buyback=20.0). Frontend: Cerca screen shows the chip row after a search — 'Solo giochi' active by default (7 rows for 'zelda'), tapping 'Tutti' expands to 20 rows adding Amiibo/LEGO/Controller/Custodia; tapping 'Solo giochi' hides them again. Result-count header text correctly reflects filtered count and appends '· solo giochi' only when the chip is active. Prices load progressively (buyback-pill x7 after 6s), add-to-quote-button adds to Preventivo (badge shows 1), valutazione-input is editable and preventivo-total updates live (€ 20,00 -> € 99,99). No React Native red screens; no deprecated Expo packages found. Cover thumbnails blank as expected (Cloudflare 403 to datacenter IP — per E1 note).

issues: Console still warns 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (use style.pointerEvents). Same warnings as iteration_1 — non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) The scraper's search occasionally returns 0 rows when the site does not render '.oe_product' within the 8s wait — this is transient and matches E1's note. Consider bumping the wait to 12s or adding a small retry inside scraper.search_games for extra resilience if flakiness bothers real users.
critical_code_review_comments: scraper.py ACCESSORY_RE heuristic is thorough (includes lego, il film, steelbook, controller, custodia, playset, portachiavi, peluche, funko, amiibo, blu-ray, 4k ultra) — verified live against Zelda and Mario result sets.
server.py exposes is_game correctly via GameRow pydantic model with default True, and reads it from the scraper item (line 126) — good.

Frontend cerca.tsx: useMemo filter (line 36-39), default onlyGames=true, chip row only rendered when state==='done' && results.length>0, dedicated 'only-accessories-state' empty state with 'Mostra tutti' CTA — thoughtful UX.
Count header correctly appends '· solo giochi' conditionally (line 249). Filtered count vs total count logic is correct.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use live GameLife.it scrape.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New file /app/backend/tests/test_search_bugfix.py covers the 502 regression + is_game flag. Both suites use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Zelda ToTK canonical URL: https://www.gamelife.it/sws20003-the-legend-of-zelda-tears-of-the-kingdom (nuovo=80.99, usato=59.99, buyback=20.0). Live searches may transiently return 0 results (site render race) — tests include retry loops (3-4 attempts). Cover images 403 from datacenter — expected. rca_of_issue: Original 502 was caused by uvicorn --reload restarting the Playwright browser on backend edits. With services stable, /api/search returns 200 reliably (verified 8 successful calls across 4 queries). No 502 observed in this run.
